protocol: Fetch the official OpenML-CC18 suite and official task/dataset metadata; exclude every frozen OpenML ID and normalized dataset name; reject UCI-origin sources and metadata-ineligible datasets; rank eligible datasets by SHA-256 of the frozen seed, task ID, dataset ID, normalized name and canonical metadata digest; download raw dataset bytes only to record byte length and SHA-256; never parse records, targets or feature values and never execute Mini-ORIGIN.
claim_boundary: Cross-source hash-lock provenance only. No records, targets or feature values are parsed and no solver is executed. This stage is not external algorithmic evidence, novelty, publication, acceptance or a world-level claim.
